mapper.sql: select history_id, user_id, keyword, search_count, last_search_time, create_time from user_search_history
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} order by last_search_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into user_search_history (user_id, keyword, search_count, last_search_time, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{keyword}, 1, now(), now()) on duplicate key update search_count = search_count + 1, last_search_time = now()
